{{Top|leg}}
The '''Outer Territories''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].

==History==
The people of these territories were at war with the kingdom of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] for generations. The [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Malameu Toda]] finally agreed to sign a charter of peace with the [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mon Julpa]] after they cooperated in the [[Rescue of Gerin Toda|rescue]] of his daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Gerin Toda]].
